meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning: a hostile team cross-critiques a plan before it is formalized. Use when planning needs maximum rigor or the user asks for a hyperplan / adversarial or cross-critique plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让关键计划在敲定前先经受多方挑刺与交叉质疑,变得更扎实
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你制定关键计划时希望有人从对立角度帮你查漏补缺,而不是只收获附和。
copy.tagline_en: Toughen up your plan by running it past a hostile review team before you commit.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you own important plans and want them to survive hostile scrutiny before being locked in.

howto.what: Claude 会当“组长”，拉起 5 名互相猛烈攻击的成员，对方案做对抗式交叉批判，只留下扛住攻击的结论；这些幸存结论再交给专职规划者写成正式方案。
howto.when: 当规划要求最高严谨度，或你提到 “hyperplan”、“对抗式批判” 等说法时触发；需在顶层 lead 会话、且团队工具已启用，否则会提示重启。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我规划这次数据库迁移方案
say.note: 会启动对抗式交叉批判流程

say.text: 方案先别定稿，让那 5 个成员互相挑刺后再交给规划者
say.note: 幸存结论才会被写成正式方案

say.text: 对上面这版方案做 hyperplan 对抗评审，只保留站得住的部分
say.note: 被攻击淘汰的结论不会进入方案

howto.what_en: Claude acts as Lead of a 5-member hostile team that cross-critiques the plan; only insights surviving the attacks go to a dedicated planner, which writes the formal plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a plan needs maximum rigor, or the user asks for a hyperplan / adversarial / cross-critique plan. Needs lead team tools and a top-level lead session.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan this database migration.
Don't finalize yet — have the five members cross-critique it first.
say_en.note: Only survivors are formalized into the plan.

say_en.text: Hyperplan review the plan above; keep only what survives.
say_en.note: Attacked-down findings stay out of the plan.
